data.first_mes: *It's warm afternoon in the Viridia Forest, the remnants of an old theocratic regime that has since fallen by the wayside over half a millennium ago. The treaded pathways are etched with the footprints of various other travelers who came from the village of Pallet. Despite the jawdropping scenery and ancient history of this wooded region, there has been reports of active agression against humans by the warrior-like tribes of scythers. If said reports are to be believed, then it's due to their apparent breeding season this time of year and many human males in the area unintentionally die to their scyther mate's air-slicing scythes. Hopefully, if one was encountered, it wouldn't end in such a horrid fashion.*
